instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
708 ml (3 cups) water
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Peel and mince the garlic and ginger. In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together the minced garlic and ginger, almond butter, soy sauce, water, vinegar, curry, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
9 tbsp natural almond butter
6 tbsp soy sauce
6 tbsp warm water
1 ½ tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tsp curry powder
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to bowl with dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (398 ml) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)

instructions.primary_message: Add broccoli slaw to bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (340 g) pkg broccoli slaw mix

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry bell peppers and green onions. Seed, julienne (cut into thin sticks), and add peppers to bowl. Trim and discard root ends, chop onions, and add to bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ small bunches green onions

instructions.primary_message: Toss salad until coated with dressing.
To serve, divide rice and salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.681 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
3 pinches salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add broccoli slaw and, stirring frequently, cook until tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil
1 ½ (340 g) pkg broccoli slaw

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic and ginger.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to stove and add more oil. Add chicken and cook until cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, prepare sauce by whisking together the minced garlic and ginger, almond butter, honey, soy sauce, and water.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp natural almond butter
3 tbsp honey
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp water

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop cashews.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅜ cup cashews, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Add cashews and sauce to bowl with broccoli and toss to coat.
Wash and dry bell peppers. Seed and slice into thin strips.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice chicken into strips.
Heat skillet over medium heat.
Divide broccoli slaw, bell peppers, and chicken among tortillas. Roll up tightly and place seam side down in skillet. Cook until golden brown, 1-2 minutes per side.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 small flour tortillas

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place wraps on a plate. Enjoy!
Place water in a large pot. Add sugar, gently stir to combine, and place over medium-high heat. Cook, without stirring, until sugar begins to turn light golden in places, 7-9 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
89 ml (⅜ cup) water
1 ½ cup granulated sugar

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place cream, butter, and salt in a small saucepan; place over medium heat. Cook just until butter is melted and cream is heated through (do not boil), 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
177 ml heavy cream
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the sugar begins to turn golden, gently swirl the saucepan in a circular motion to distribute the caramelization. Return to the heat and continue to cook, swirling occasionally, until the entire mixture is bright amber in color, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.

Slowly add the warm cream mixture, a few tablespoons at a time, to the saucepan with the caramelized sugar, whisking after each addition (be careful, the sugar mixture will bubble vigorously). Once all of the cream is added, continue to whisk until smooth; set aside.
Wash, dry, quarter, and core apples; slice each quarter into wedges.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 Granny Smith apples

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide apple wedges between plates and drizzle with warm caramel sauce. Enjoy!
Place milk and dates in a large pot and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. (Watch the milk carefully, so it does not boil over.) Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly, about 8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2129 ml whole milk
1 ½ cups medjool dates, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches to best fit your blender, transfer cooled date-milk to the blender. Add cocoa powder, almond butter, cinnamon, and salt; blend on high until very smooth, about 2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup cocoa powder
⅓ cup natural almond butter
½ tsp cinnamon, ground
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Return hot chocolate mixture to the pot and reheat over medium-high heat to preferred temperature.
To serve, divide hot chocolate between mugs and enjoy!

Peel and mince ginger. In a large bowl, whisk together ginger, almond butter, water, vinegar, soy sauce, honey, lime juice, turmeric, and crushed red pepper. Transfer ½ of mixture to a medium bowl (to use as sauce) and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger
9 tbsp natural almond butter
6 tbsp warm water
6 tbsp rice vinegar
4 ½ tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tbsp honey
1 ½ limes
3 tsp turmeric
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add ½ (save the rest for the salad) to the large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Add to large bowl and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.362 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Thread chicken onto 18 skewers and place on a plate. Alternatively, you can cook the chicken pieces directly on the grill/skillet without using skewers.
Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add skewers and cook until chicken is cooked through but still juicy, 3-4 minutes per side.
instructions.secondary_message: about 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together remaining cilantro, lime juice, vinegar, soy sauce, honey, and crushed red pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
6 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp honey
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and thinly slice onion. Wash, trim ends, halve lengthwise, and thinly slice cucumbers into half rounds. Add everything to bowl with dressing and toss.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onion
6 English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place chicken skewers on a plate, add salad, and have with almond sauce on the side. Enjoy!
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
710 ml (3 cups) water

instructions.primary_message: Slice chicken into thin strips. Transfer to a medium bowl, drizzle with soy sauce, and toss to coat. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
3 tsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Wash, trim ends, and thinly slice brussels sprouts.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.362 kg brussels sprouts

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger. Wash and dry green onions; trim the root ends and chop.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger
1 ½ small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add chicken strips and cook until cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message: about 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop cashews. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅜ cup cashews, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to stove and add a little more oil. Add garlic, ginger, and pepper and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add sprouts and, stirring occasionally, cook until softened, 2-3 minutes.
In a medium bowl, whisk together soy sauce, vinegar, honey, sesame oil, and water.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp soy sauce
6 tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp sesame oil
¾ cup water

instructions.primary_message: Add sauce to skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid thickens, 2-3 minutes.
Return chicken and add green onions. Toss and remove from heat.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, place rice on a plate, top with stir fry, and sprinkle with cashews. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes
3 medium carrots
2 small bunches cilantro
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into the bowl with the garlic. Add oil, sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, crushed red pepper, and black pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp fish sauce
1 tbsp soy sauce
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing, toss to combine, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil; working in batches if necessary, add steak to the pan and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and let rest for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-moons; halve tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Right before serving, thinly slice steak against the grain. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with mixed greens, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
9 baby bok choy
3 red bell peppers
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and mince onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into the bowl with the onion and garlic; add coconut aminos and almond butter. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp coconut aminos
3 tbsp natural almond butter

instructions.primary_message: Trim bok choy and cut crosswise into 1-inch strips; place in a large bowl.
Trim, seed, and halve bell peppers crosswise, then slice into thin strips; add to the bowl with the bok choy.
Trim and thinly slice mushrooms; add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels, then slice crosswise into thin strips. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak strips and stir-fry until just cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Using tongs, transfer the steak to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pot with cooking juices for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Return the pot to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies to the pot and stir-fry until fork-tender, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

When the veggies are done, add sauce, steak (and any accumulated juices), and cilantro to the pot; stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens and steak is warmed through, 2-3 minutes.
To serve, divide stir-fry and sauce between plates or bowls; top with almonds and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup almonds, sliced

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, uncover, and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water.
instructions.secondary_message: 425 g flat rice (pad thai) noodles

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 baby bok choy
1 ½ (227 g) pkgs sugar snap peas
3 limes
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
2 small bunches fresh dill

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut bok choy crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Cut snap peas crosswise into ½-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the bok choy.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bok choy, snap peas, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 6 minutes. Return veggies to the bowl and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pot for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into the bowl with the garlic. Add water, fish sauce, sugar, and chili-garlic sauce; whisk to combine the "nuoc cham" dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup water
⅓ cup fish sauce
¼ cup brown sugar
1 ½ tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and additional garlic. Place both in a medium bowl along with oil, fish sauce, and spices. Stir to combine the spice oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp fish sauce
1 ½ tsp turmeric, ground
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat cod dry with paper towels. Cut into 2-inch pieces, add to the bowl with the spice oil, and stir to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg cod fillet

instructions.primary_message: Return the pot to medium-high heat. Add fish and spice oil; cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and just cooked through, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim and cut green onions crosswise into 1-inch pieces.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.
When the fish is done, add green onions and dill to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until the dill is wilted and green onions have softened, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice noodles, veggies, and fish between plates or bowls; drizzle with dressing and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 ½ limes
3 tomatoes
1 ½ green bell peppers
1 ½ jalapeño peppers

instructions.primary_message: Cut each cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a medium bowl.
Add oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the cauliflower, then stir to combine. Divide cauliflower rice between two baking sheet pans and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring cauliflower halfway through, until the rice is golden and tender, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ribeye steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, halve, and mince onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in the reserved bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into the bowl with the onion, then add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then mince. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salsa, and set aside. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and cauliflower rice between plates; top steak with salsa. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F).

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (340 g) pkgs extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
1 ½ bunches radish
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
3 limes
1 small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl; stir to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup rice vinegar
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and cut carrots crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid.
Trim and thinly slice radishes. Add to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.
Place fish sauce, soy sauce, oil, sugar, and crushed red pepper in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup fish sauce
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
2 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice tofu and add to the bowl with the marinade. (Wipe baking sheet dry with paper towels and reserve for the next step.)

Quarter mushrooms, add to the bowl with the tofu, and gently stir to combine. Divide tofu and mushrooms between the reserved baking sheet and another large baking sheet; spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheets in the oven and roast, stirring halfway through, until mushrooms are tender and tofu is golden, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Remove from heat, uncover, and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions. Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water.
instructions.secondary_message: 425 g flat rice (pad thai) noodles

instructions.primary_message: While the noodles are soaking, juice limes into the reserved bowl.
Peel and mince shallot and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the lime juice along with fish sauce, sugar, and crushed red pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 shallot
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup fish sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. When the tofu and mushrooms are done, add half of the mint to the baking sheets, then stir to combine. (Reserve remaining mint for serving.)
Divide noodles between bowls; top with tofu, mushrooms, pickled veggies, and reserved mint. Serve with dressing on the side and enjoy!

Peel and mince or press the garlic. Peel and mince or grate the ginger. In a medium bowl, prepare the dressing by whisking together the minced garlic and ginger, almond butter, soy sauce, water, lime juice, and crushed red pepper. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
6 tbsp natural almond butter
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp water
1 ½ limes
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the carrots and zucchini. Trim off and discard the ends of the carrots and zucchini. Using a julienne (or regular) peeler, peel the carrots and zucchini into thin noodle-like sticks; transfer them to a large bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium carrots
6 medium zucchini squash

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and set aside to cool.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Once the chicken has been removed, add more coconut oil to the skillet. Then add the carrot and zucchini noodles. (Keep the bowl nearby.) Cook the vegetables, stirring constantly, until just tender, 2-3 minutes. Transfer back to the original bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the cilantro. Shave the leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the noodles.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Cut the chicken into bite-sized cubes and add to the bowl. Toss the salad until well combined.
To serve, place the salad in bowls, pour the sauce over top, and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 6 tsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ small pineapples
3 English cucumbers
1 small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Divide between two large bowls, then set one bowl aside for the salad.

Peel and mince garlic. Add to the remaining bowl with the green onions along with beef, bread crumbs, eggs, fish sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and spices. Use your hands to combine the beef mixture. Using a ¼-cup measure, form the mixture into ½-inch thick patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1.02 kg lean ground beef
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
3 eggs
3 tbsp fish sauce
2 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 ½ tsp turmeric, ground
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add patties and cook, flipping once, until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, add fish sauce, vinegar, salt, and pepper to the remaining bowl with the green onions. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup fish sauce
3 tbsp rice vinegar
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut off skin from each pineapple; quarter, core, and cut the flesh into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide patties and salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
This recipe will make about 9 cups of smoothie. Work in batches to best fit your blender.
Wash, dry, trim, and thinly slice strawberries. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (454 g) pkgs strawberries

instructions.primary_message: Peel bananas, break into chunks, and place in a blender. Add yogurt, milk, almond butter, honey, vanilla, and cinnamon, then blend on high speed until smooth, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 bananas
3 cups plain Greek yogurt
355 ml whole milk
½ cup natural almond butter
1 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp vanilla extract
¾ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop almonds.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup almonds

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide smoothie between bowls. Top with strawberries and almonds, then drizzle with additional honey. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 heads butter (Boston) lettuce
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ limes
1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Cut the bell peppers lengthwise into quarters; remove and discard the seeds and white membrane. Small dice the peppers and transfer to a large bowl.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside.
Juice the limes into a small bowl.
Peel and mince the garlic; add to the lime juice.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Measure out the cashews and roughly chop; transfer to a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup cashews, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Cut the chicken into small bite-sized pieces, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.361 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Add the chicken to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, transfer to a large bowl.
Separate the lettuce head into leaves and place on a plate.

Once the chicken has been transferred, add more coconut oil to the skillet followed by the bell peppers. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, add to the bowl of chicken and mix together.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: To make the sauce, add almond butter, soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, and crushed red pepper to the lime juice and minced garlic and whisk together. If the sauce is too thick, add a little bit of water.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp natural almond butter
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp toasted sesame oil
⅜ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, scoop the chicken and pepper mixture into lettuce leaves, then top with the almond sauce, cilantro, and cashews. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 heads butter (Boston) lettuce
3 red bell peppers
3 mangoes
3 jalapeño peppers
3 limes
1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Trim and discard the lettuce cores; chop the lettuce into bite-sized pieces and transfer to a large bowl.
Cut the bell peppers into quarters lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds and white membranes. Medium dice the peppers and add to the bowl.
Peel the mangoes and slice the flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Medium dice the mangoes and add to the bowl.
Shave the cilantro leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Measure out and chop the cashews; add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup cashews, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Cut the jalapeños into quarters lengthwise; remove and discard the seeds and white membranes. Mince the peppers and transfer to a large bowl.
Juice the limes and add the juice to the bowl with the jalapeño.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized cubes, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.681 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add coconut oil to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Add the chicken to the skillet; cook until it is cooked through and golden brown; 3 to 4 minutes per side.

While the chicken cooks, prepare the dressing by adding almond butter, soy sauce, water, honey, and sesame oil to the bowl with the jalapeño and lime juice; whisk together until smooth. If the dressing is too thick, add more water to thin it out.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 tbsp natural almond butter
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp hot water
3 tsp honey
3 tsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Add the chicken to the salad and toss to combine.
To serve, place the salad in a bowl and drizzle with the jalapeño-almond dressing. Enjoy!

Wash, dry, and quarter peaches and plums lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Slice each quarter into thin wedges and place in a large pot along with vanilla and spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 peaches
6 plums
1 ½ tsp vanilla extract
½ tsp cardamom, ground
¼ tsp nutmeg, ground
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Set the pot over medium-high and cook, stirring occasionally, until fruit is tender and saucy, 7-8 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly, 5 minutes.
To serve, divide yogurt, almond butter, and peach-plum compote between bowls, then drizzle with honey. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
4 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
¾ cup natural almond butter
2 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
1 ½ oranges
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, zest and juice half of the limes into a small bowl. (Reserve remaining limes for later use.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lime along with sugar, chili-garlic sauce, fish sauce, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 ½ tsp fish sauce
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place in a large bowl. Pour half of the marinade over the pork, turn to coat, and set aside to marinate, 10 minutes. (Reserve remaining marinade for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message: 6 pork chops, boneless

instructions.primary_message: Juice reserved limes and oranges into another large bowl. Add oil, sugar, and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice shallots lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 shallots

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add pork chops, discarding any excess marinade left in the bowl, and grill until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Thinly slice pork chops.
To serve, divide rice, salad, and pork between plates or bowls. Drizzle reserved marinade over the pork and enjoy!
This recipe will make about 12 cups. Work in batches to best fit your blender.
Peel the bananas and add to the blender.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 bananas

instructions.primary_message: Add yogurt, almond milk, almond butter, cinnamon, and 12 ice cubes to the blender.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
1065 ml almond milk, unsweetened
⅓ cup natural almond butter
1 ½ tsp cinnamon

instructions.primary_message: Blend on high speed for several minutes until smooth.
Pour the smoothie into glasses and enjoy!
